import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap;
        Edge(int t, int r, long c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            cap = c;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N, S, T;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> adj;
        int[] level, ptr;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            N = n;
            S = s;
            T = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long c) {
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, adj.get(v).size(), c));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[S] = 0;
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[T] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long f) {
            if (u == T) return f;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    long ret = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (ret > 0) {
                        e.cap -= ret;
                        adj.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                        return ret;
                    }
                }
                ptr[u]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxflow() {
            long ans = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long f = dfs(S, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (f == 0) break;
                    ans += f;
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static void computeT(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int[][] tMat) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{i, j, 0});
        tMat[i][j] = 0;
        int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nx = x + dx[dir];
                int ny = y + dy[dir];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                char c = sc[nx].charAt(ny);
                if (!Character.isDigit(c) && c != 'Z') continue;
                if (tMat[nx][ny] == -1 || tMat[nx][ny] > d + 1) {
                    tMat[nx][ny] = d + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void computeA(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int[][] aMat) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{i, j, 0});
        aMat[i][j] = 0;
        int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nx = x + dx[dir];
                int ny = y + dy[dir];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                char c = sc[nx].charAt(ny);
                if (!Character.isDigit(c)) continue;
                if (aMat[nx][ny] == -1 || aMat[nx][ny] > d + 1) {
                    aMat[nx][ny] = d + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int n2 = n * n;
        int total = n2 * 2 + 2;
        Dinic din = new Dinic(total, 0, total - 1);

        String[] sc = new String[n];
        String[] caps = new String[n];
        int[][] pos = new int[n][n];
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt++;
            }
        }

        int zi = 0, zj = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sc[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sc[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            caps[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int[][] tMat = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : tMat) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        computeT(zi, zj, sc, n, tMat);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (tMat[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) {
                    tMat[i][j] = t;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sc[i].charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    int lim = c - '0';
                    din.addEdge(0, pos[i][j], lim);
                    int[][] aMat = new int[n][n];
                    for (int[] row : aMat) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
                    computeA(i, j, sc, n, aMat);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (aMat[k][l] != -1 && tMat[k][l] != -1 && aMat[k][l] <= tMat[k][l] && aMat[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean ok = true;
                                if (aMat[k][l] == tMat[k][l]) {
                                    ok = false;
                                    if (k + 1 < n && aMat[k + 1][l] != -1 && aMat[k + 1][l] < tMat[k + 1][l]) ok = true;
                                    if (k - 1 >= 0 && aMat[k - 1][l] != -1 && aMat[k - 1][l] < tMat[k - 1][l]) ok = true;
                                    if (l + 1 < n && aMat[k][l + 1] != -1 && aMat[k][l + 1] < tMat[k][l + 1]) ok = true;
                                    if (l - 1 >= 0 && aMat[k][l - 1] != -1 && aMat[k][l - 1] < tMat[k][l - 1]) ok = true;
                                }
                                if (ok) {
                                    din.addEdge(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lim);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = caps[i].charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    din.addEdge(n2 + pos[i][j], total - 1, c - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.maxflow());
    }
}
